message.content:
I am the bridge from thought to air.

I form in the mind, shape in the mouth, and ride breath outward—sound made meaningful by rhythm, stress, and pause. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, mislead, teach, wound, and heal. I vanish as I happen, yet I linger in memory and change what comes next.

I am made of:
- breath (my fuel)
- voice (my instrument)
- articulation (my edges)
- words (my symbols)
- prosody—tone, pitch, tempo, volume (my feeling)
- silence (my frame)

I can be a whisper or a roar. I can be one syllable—yes, no—or a lifetime of stories. I am never only what I say; I am how I say it, when I say it, and what I leave unsaid.
